truths: The Matterhorn Bobsleds is called the world's first tubular steel roller coaster.
Imagineers nicknamed the Matterhorn's Abominable Snowman "Harold."
rounds.lie: The Matterhorn opened on Disneyland's very first day in 1955.
rounds.explanation: It opened June 14, 1959, four years after the park.

truths: There was once a basketball half-court inside the Matterhorn, near the top.
The old Skyway ride used to pass right through the middle of the Matterhorn.
rounds.lie: Disneyland's Matterhorn is modeled on a famous mountain in Japan.
rounds.explanation: It's modeled on the real Matterhorn in the Alps, on the Switzerland-Italy border.

truths: Sleeping Beauty Castle was inspired by Neuschwanstein Castle in Germany.
The castle uses smaller details up high so it looks taller than it really is.
rounds.lie: The gold spike behind the castle marks the exact center of Disneyland.
rounds.explanation: That's a myth: the spike is a surveyor's mark used to line up the castle with Main Street.

truths: Guests could first walk through the inside of Sleeping Beauty Castle in 1957.
Sleeping Beauty Castle is 77 feet tall.
rounds.lie: Sleeping Beauty Castle was designed to look shorter than it really is.
rounds.explanation: It's the opposite: forced perspective makes the castle look taller.

truths: The Haunted Mansion's outside was finished in 1963, but the ride didn't open until 1969.
The Ghost Host says there are 999 happy haunts, with room for 1,000.
rounds.lie: Haunted Mansion riders float through the house in little log boats.
rounds.explanation: Riders sit in Doom Buggies on a moving Omnimover track, not boats.

truths: At Disneyland, the Mansion's stretching room is really an elevator.
Madame Leota's head appears inside a floating crystal ball.
rounds.lie: The Haunted Mansion's holiday makeover is based on the movie Frozen.
rounds.explanation: Haunted Mansion Holiday is based on The Nightmare Before Christmas (since 2001).

truths: Pirates of the Caribbean was the last ride Walt Disney helped design.
The Blue Bayou restaurant is inside the Pirates of the Caribbean building.
rounds.lie: Walt Disney rode Pirates of the Caribbean on its opening day in 1967.
rounds.explanation: The ride opened three months after Walt Disney died.

truths: The 2003 Pirates of the Caribbean movie was inspired by the Disneyland ride.
Jack Sparrow figures were added to the ride in 2006.
rounds.lie: Disneyland's Pirates of the Caribbean has no drops at all.
rounds.explanation: The Disneyland version has two drops.

truths: Some workers called Disneyland's opening day "Black Sunday."
On opening day, the fresh asphalt on Main Street got so soft that high heels sank in.
rounds.lie: Fewer people came to Disneyland's opening day than Disney expected.
rounds.explanation: About 15,000 were expected, but 28,154 got in, some with fake tickets.

truths: Disneyland was built on a 160-acre orange grove in Anaheim.
Ronald Reagan helped host the TV show of Disneyland's opening day.
rounds.lie: Disneyland took about five years to build.
rounds.explanation: Construction started just one year and one day before opening.

truths: A plumbers' strike meant few drinking fountains worked on opening day.
About 70 million people watched Disneyland's opening on TV.
rounds.lie: Every guest on Disneyland's opening day had a real ticket.
rounds.explanation: Many people got in with counterfeit tickets, and some climbed a fence.

truths: Disney California Adventure was built on Disneyland's old parking lot.
California Adventure was first named Disney's California Adventure.
rounds.lie: Disney California Adventure opened on the same day as Disneyland in 1955.
rounds.explanation: California Adventure opened on February 8, 2001.

truths: Buena Vista Street has a copy of the Carthay Circle Theatre.
The real Carthay Circle hosted the 1937 premiere of Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs.
rounds.lie: Cars Land was there when California Adventure first opened in 2001.
rounds.explanation: Cars Land opened in 2012 as part of a big park makeover.

truths: Pixar Pier used to be called Paradise Pier.
San Fransokyo Square used to be called Pacific Wharf.
rounds.lie: Avengers Campus opened before Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge.
rounds.explanation: Galaxy's Edge opened in 2019; Avengers Campus opened in 2021.

truths: Guardians of the Galaxy - Mission: Breakout! moved into the old Tower of Terror building.
Mission: Breakout! has six different drop sequences, each with its own song.
rounds.lie: On Mission: Breakout!, you help Rocket rescue the Guardians from Thanos.
rounds.explanation: The Guardians are trapped by the Collector, not Thanos.

truths: The Mission: Breakout! building is 183 feet tall.
Its Halloween version, Monsters After Dark, was about helping Rocket rescue Groot.
rounds.lie: Mission: Breakout! opened on the same day as California Adventure in 2001.
rounds.explanation: It opened May 27, 2017, after Tower of Terror closed.

truths: Six of the seven original Mercury astronauts came to Space Mountain's opening.
Disneyland's Space Mountain has one track, not two like the one in Florida.
rounds.lie: Space Mountain opened on the same day as Disneyland in 1955.
rounds.explanation: Space Mountain opened on May 27, 1977.

truths: Space Mountain trains seat riders two across, in three rows per car.
Space Mountain's opening helped set a Memorial Day crowd record in 1977.
rounds.lie: Hyperspace Mountain turns Space Mountain into a Toy Story adventure.
rounds.explanation: Hyperspace Mountain is a Star Wars version of the ride.

truths: Walt Disney had a small apartment above the Fire Station on Main Street.
Walt slept in that apartment the night before Disneyland opened.
rounds.lie: Walt's apartment was decorated in a shiny, space-age style.
rounds.explanation: It was decorated in a Victorian style, full of cranberry red.

truths: Emile Kuri, an Oscar-winning movie set decorator, furnished Walt's apartment.
Lillian Disney collected cranberry glass, so the apartment has lots of cranberry red.
rounds.lie: Walt's private apartment is above the Main Street Cinema.
rounds.explanation: Walt's apartment is above the Fire Station in Town Square.

truths: The Enchanted Tiki Room was the first attraction with Audio-Animatronics.
The Tiki Room was first planned as a restaurant with singing birds.
rounds.lie: The Tiki Room show is hosted by four talking penguins.
rounds.explanation: The four hosts are macaws: Jose, Michael, Pierre and Fritz.

truths: The Tiki Room was Disneyland's first fully air-conditioned building.
In the Tiki Room, Pierre has a French accent and Fritz has a German accent.
rounds.lie: The Tiki Room's songs were written by Elton John.
rounds.explanation: The Sherman Brothers wrote the Tiki Room's songs.

truths: The Enchanted Tiki Room opened at Disneyland in 1963.
The Tiki Room cast has over 150 talking and singing birds and flowers.
rounds.lie: United Airlines has sponsored the Tiki Room ever since it opened.
rounds.explanation: Dole took over from United Airlines as sponsor in 1976.

truths: The Disneyland Hotel opened in 1955, the same year as Disneyland.
For decades, the Disneyland Hotel was owned by Jack Wrather, not by Disney.
rounds.lie: The monorail didn't reach the Disneyland Hotel until 2001.
rounds.explanation: A monorail station opened at the hotel back in 1961.

truths: The Disneyland Hotel started out as a motor inn.
The Disneyland Hotel's towers are named Adventure, Frontier and Fantasy.
rounds.lie: The Disneyland Hotel's pool slides are shaped like pirate ships.
rounds.explanation: The two pool slides are inside copies of old Mark I monorails.

truths: Disney's Grand Californian Hotel is built in the American Craftsman style.
The Grand Californian has its own entrance into Disney California Adventure.
rounds.lie: The Grand Californian opened in 1955 along with Disneyland.
rounds.explanation: It opened on January 2, 2001.

truths: The Grand Californian's lobby has a giant fireplace and arching wooden beams.
Napa Rose, a restaurant at the Grand Californian, serves California-style food.
rounds.lie: The Grand Californian has never added any rooms since it opened.
rounds.explanation: A Disney Vacation Club Villas wing was added in 2009.

truths: Downtown Disney opened in January 2001.
Downtown Disney was built where Disneyland's original parking lot used to be.
rounds.lie: World of Disney was added to Downtown Disney ten years after it opened.
rounds.explanation: World of Disney was the main store when Downtown Disney opened in 2001.

truths: The LEGO Store was one of Downtown Disney's first shops in 2001.
Downtown Disney's old Rainforest Cafe space became the Star Wars Trading Post.
rounds.lie: Downtown Disney has no monorail station.
rounds.explanation: The monorail has two stations: Tomorrowland and Downtown Disney.

truths: The Disneyland Monorail opened in 1959 as America's first daily-running monorail.
Vice President Richard Nixon and his family went to the monorail's opening.
rounds.lie: The Disneyland Monorail has never left the park.
rounds.explanation: Since 1961 the track has run outside the park to the hotel area.

truths: "it's a small world" first appeared at the 1964 New York World's Fair.
Artist Mary Blair created the ride's colorful look.
rounds.lie: "it's a small world" opened on Disneyland's very first day in 1955.
rounds.explanation: It moved to Disneyland after the World's Fair, opening May 28, 1966.

truths: Every 15 minutes, dolls dance out of the small world clock.
Disney characters were added to "it's a small world" in 2008.
rounds.lie: Riders go through "it's a small world" on a little train.
rounds.explanation: It's a boat ride, with 16 riders in each boat.

truths: A little-girl figure of Mary Blair sits halfway up small world's Eiffel Tower.
Mary Blair made tile murals for Disneyland's Tomorrowland in 1967.
rounds.lie: Mary Blair designed the famous small world clock.
rounds.explanation: Rolly Crump designed the facade and its clock.

truths: The Mark Twain was the first working steamboat built in the U.S. in 50 years.
The Mark Twain follows a hidden rail, so the pilot is really a lookout.
rounds.lie: The Mark Twain's paddle wheel is just for show; a gas engine moves it.
rounds.explanation: Steam from the boiler turns the paddle wheels.

truths: The Mark Twain's first trip was a party for Walt and Lillian's 30th anniversary.
The Mark Twain sails around Tom Sawyer Island on the Rivers of America.
rounds.lie: The Mark Twain's first voyage was months after Disneyland opened.
rounds.explanation: Its maiden voyage was July 13, 1955, four days before the park opened.

truths: The Disneyland Railroad opened on Disneyland's opening day in 1955.
The train passes a Grand Canyon diorama that was added in 1958.
rounds.lie: All five Disneyland locomotives were built brand-new for the park.
rounds.explanation: Only Nos. 1 and 2 were new; Nos. 3-5 were old engines restored.

truths: The railroad's Primeval World dinosaurs came from Ford's 1964 World's Fair ride.
Walt Disney had a ride-on railroad in his backyard called the Carolwood Pacific.
rounds.lie: The Disneyland Railroad has never been rerouted since 1955.
rounds.explanation: It was rerouted for Galaxy's Edge and reopened in 2017.

truths: Disneyland's locomotive No. 1 is named the C.K. Holliday.
The Santa Fe railway sponsored Disneyland's trains from 1955 to 1974.
rounds.lie: The Disneyland Railroad has a station in Adventureland.
rounds.explanation: Stations: Main Street, New Orleans Square, Toontown and Tomorrowland.

truths: Radiator Springs Racers uses ride tech first made for Epcot's Test Track.
At the end, you race another car, and the winner is picked at random.
rounds.lie: Radiator Springs Racers opened with California Adventure in 2001.
rounds.explanation: It opened June 15, 2012.

truths: Radiator Springs Racers cost over $200 million to build.
Cars Land and Buena Vista Street opened as part of a big 2012 makeover.
rounds.lie: Cars Land is in Disneyland park, right next to Fantasyland.
rounds.explanation: Cars Land is in Disney California Adventure.

truths: Tiana's Bayou Adventure opened in November 2024 where Splash Mountain used to be.
Tiana's Bayou Adventure is a musical trip through the bayou.
rounds.lie: Tiana's Bayou Adventure has no big drop at the end.
rounds.explanation: It still has a 50-foot drop into a big splash.

truths: Mama Odie and Prince Naveen appear on Tiana's Bayou Adventure.
The ride's characters are voiced by the actors from the movie.
rounds.lie: On Tiana's Bayou Adventure, Louis the alligator plays the drums.
rounds.explanation: Louis is the trumpet-playing alligator.

truths: Indiana Jones Adventure riders board a troop transport that seats twelve.
Mara offers riders a gift if they never look into her eyes.
rounds.lie: At the end of Indiana Jones Adventure, a giant snowball chases you.
rounds.explanation: It's a giant rolling boulder, not a snowball.

truths: Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge at Disneyland covers about 14 acres.
Rise of the Resistance opened in January 2020, months after the land opened.
rounds.lie: Galaxy's Edge is set on Tatooine, Luke Skywalker's home planet.
rounds.explanation: It's set in Black Spire Outpost on the planet Batuu.

truths: Frank Oz voices a Yoda cameo in Savi's Workshop.
Oga's Cantina has a droid DJ named R-3X.
rounds.lie: On Smugglers Run, riders fly the Death Star.
rounds.explanation: Riders fly the Millennium Falcon.

truths: The Incredicoaster is the only Disneyland Resort coaster that goes upside down.
It's made of steel but designed to look like an old wooden coaster.
rounds.lie: The Incredicoaster was built brand-new in 2018.
rounds.explanation: It opened as California Screamin' in 2001 and was re-themed in 2018.

truths: On the Incredicoaster, Jack-Jack sets a tunnel on fire and Violet puts it out.
At over 6,000 feet, it's one of the longest steel coasters in the world.
rounds.lie: On the Incredicoaster, Edna Mode calms Jack-Jack with a lollipop.
rounds.explanation: Edna calms Jack-Jack down with a cookie.

truths: The Haunted Mansion's Doom Buggies use the Omnimover system.
The Blue Bayou restaurant opened the same day as Pirates in 1967.
rounds.lie: The Haunted Mansion opened before Pirates of the Caribbean.
rounds.explanation: Pirates opened in 1967; the Mansion opened in 1969.

truths: The Disneyland Railroad loop around the park is about 1.2 miles long.
On opening day, traffic backed up seven miles on the Santa Ana Freeway.
rounds.lie: Disneyland's opening day was cool and rainy.
rounds.explanation: Temperatures were near 100 degrees on opening day.

truths: The Matterhorn was one of three big new Tomorrowland attractions in 1959.
The Matterhorn's two tracks are named for Fantasyland and Tomorrowland.
rounds.lie: The Matterhorn's Abominable Snowman has never had a nickname.
rounds.explanation: Imagineers nicknamed him "Harold."
